data.name: Terrain Master ATV
data.shortDescription: Adds fully functional multiplayer compatible ATVs to the game.
data.description:
Adds a multiplayer compatible, fully functioning, gas powered ATV that you can ride around island.


### Features:


- Supports 1 passenger. Kelvin, Virginia or 1 player can ride along.
- Built for speed and tricky terrain. This ATV can be parked on any slope without sliding away, handles slopes amazingly well and moves faster then golf carts.
- Capable of jumping to help navigate tricky terrain.
- Doesn't damage player made structures. 
- Gas powered. Ideal for nighttime traveling if you know where to get gas.

### Disadvantages it has vs the golf cart

- No radio. 
- No gps.
- Larger hitbox
- Sinks if it lands in deep water.
- If you don't know where to get gas, you may get stranded without it more easily.
- Less light. However lights remain on even when out of the ATV.

### Where to find:

Look near human encampments for ATVs. If you want to test it out, press Shift P to spawn one in. Clients cannot spawn one in multiplayer.

### Where do I get Gasoline?

Youll find jerrycans with gas in cannibal and human camps all over the island. Pick them up and bring them to the ATV where the light bulb is and press E to add gas. All ATVs start with 200 gas. Each gas tank restores 100+ fuel. If you run out of fuel you will be automatically ejected. Fuel respawns in 20 minutes. In multiplayer fuel tanks are consumed by whoever grabs the fuel tank first.

### How does it handle enemies?

The player is immune while in the ATV, but touching cannibals takes away 5 fuel which can get you ejected. Crashing into trees costs you 2 fuel.

https://youtu.be/eYJeHFEZHmY

Note: The download only contains the manifest, license and credits. To get access to this mod dm RegiRockn'roll in the SOTF discord to see if you qualify for early access.

data.name: Immersive Companion Injuries (Beta)
data.shortDescription: Provides a more immersive injury and healing system to companions.
data.description:
I always found it very immersion breaking how Kelvin and Virginia can be healed from a potentially life threatening injury by just holding E for a short time. This mod addresses that by making there be genuine consequences for your companion getting injured and providing an immersive solution to healing them.

### What this mod does

Whenever Kelvin or Virginia fall into an injured state they must be brought to a bed and set to rest for 1 real time hour(customizable). They no longer heal and revive on their own. After sleeping for 1 hour they will awake at full health.

You also have the option of assigning permadeath to Kelvin or Virginia if you don't do it in a certain time in mod configs. THIS IS OFF BY DEFAULT.

### How to bring Kelvin and/or Virginia to a bed.

There is a new icon that appears on Kelvin and Virginia in an injured state. Hold E to pick them up and Control Y to drop them in the nearest beds. When you are close enough you will get a notification and a green light indicating you can place them on the bed. Double beds can hold 2 companion npcs. You can also press Control U to set down Kelvin and Virgina anywhere. They will remain in their injured state. If you don't like these keybinds it can be changed in mod configs.

### Does this work with multiple Kelvin's and Virginia's

Yes.

### What happens if the bed Kelvin and/or Virginia is on gets destroyed or moved?

They will fall to the ground. However there is a known bug that if Kelvin or Virginia are on a bed and it gets destroyed, any other companion npcs cannot be properly placed in bed. Restart the game if this happens.

### Can Kelvin and Virginia be hurt while in bed?

No.

### Editing Health

You can edit health in the mod configs if you think they are too weak.

### Multiplayer

Only works as the host in multiplayer right now.

https://youtu.be/b0EtHwrG7RY

If you want to see a video on how this mod works, look here.

data.name: Kelvin Can Attack + Spotlights
data.shortDescription: Adds a buildable mounted spear launchers, spotlights and a kick attack to Kelvin. Prevents fleeing.
data.description:
The time has come. No longer is Kelvin just a worker you give orders to. Now he can pack the heart with new mounted weapon systems! This mod allows you to build mounted spear launchers and spotlights to light the way.

## What the mounted spear launchers do:

They will fire spears at any enemy Kelvin encounters. Friendly targets won't trigger the spear launchers to be fired. However be careful. If you are in the line of sight when Kelvin is firing it can hurt you and Virginia. 

Kelvin also no longer runs away from enemies. However he may still cower sometimes.

## Kelvin's Melee Kick

If an enemy is nearby the kelvin will kick the enemy. By default the kick damage is very low. I recommend setting it to around 150-300. You can also adjust Kelvin's health. I recommend setting it to around 500-1000.

## The Spotlights

You can also build spotlights on Kelvin that will light the way as he walks around.

## How to build the spear launchers and spotlights

All spear launchers and spotlights structures in the game now come with a new icon. Bring Kelvin within 10 range of a spear launcher or spotlight then hold E to build it in the nearest Kelvin. The original structure will be destroyed and rebuilt on Kelvin. NOTE: In order to build spotlights on kelvin you must FIRST have built a spear launcher on him. Then save the game to keep them.

## Does the work for multiple kelvins?

Yes. When setting them up though it works based on the nearest Kelvin.


## Multiplayer: 

Only is adjustable as host to prevent game disruption. Enemies killed and the spears made sync, but not the structures on Kelvin themselves.

https://youtu.be/A8rrwWk0x2I

This video shows you step by step how to set the spear launchers and spotlights up on Kelvin.

#### If you want to remove existing mounted spear launchers.

Press Shift +R. Removes them on the nearest Kelvin.

data.name: Coop Server Tools(Beta)
data.shortDescription: Allows for hiding maps, gps and indicators icons in coop. Tells a server host the modlist a client is using.
data.description:
This mod has 2 import features:

#### Shows you a list mods a client is using

If someone also has this mod and joins your server you will get a list of the mods they are using on the Redloader Console.

#### Allows you to disable player location indicators for everyone in coop.

This includes all maps, gps icons, player usernames etc. Your location can be truly secret. This is excellent if you want to do coop pvp.

#### How to use this mod

First find someone you trust to do coop with you. Tell them to install this mod. Once they are in game check the Redloader console that allows loads with the game. If they have this mod installed you should see something like:
[CoopServerTools] mysteamfriend has CoopServerTools installed!

Followed by a list of all mods they are using. You will also get a notification in game shortly after they join.

If you don't see their name show up it means they don't have it installed. If you see they are using a list of mods that you don't want used on the server at that point you can decide the appropriate action.

#### Can clients edit the settings?

Not if they have this mod installed. If they have this mod installed it will override any attempts to change the host settings. However if you see someone running Unity Explorer or GPSRemover tell them to remove it before the game continues.

data.name: Virginia Hug Emote
data.shortDescription: Restores the cut Virginia hug interaction with the player.
data.description:
This mod restores a cut Virginia Hug interaction with the player. By default you also gain a stamina recovery buff for 5 minutes when you do this and it grants you extra virginia sentiment. Virginia will also giggle shortly after being hugged with one of 20 voicelines.

### How to hug Virginia

Stand next to Virginia and press Shift+O. If you want to stop the hug press Shift+U. This will also cancel the stamina buff.

### You can customize the following in this mod:

1. Whether or not the player also triggers an animation during the hug.  For some users they may prefer this off to avoid clipping.
2. How loud her giggle voice after hugs is.
3. Whether or not there is a stamina buff.
4. How much stamina recovery you get from it if any. 
5. How long the stamina buff lasts(5 minutes by default).

### Other things to note:

1. Endnight cut this interaction from the game because they were worried it would cause problems since it locks the player in place. This mod solves this by allowing you to interrupt it at any time.

2. This is not a perfect restoration. I could not find a corresponding hug animation on the player so I had to improvise by using one of the other player animations. And to ensure Virginia is running smoothly after the hug ends, I had to reinitialize her AI which results in a temporary stutter. 

3. The voice lines found in this mod are replaceable wav files. In case you want to use something else. None of the clips were generated with AI.

### Virginia will not hug you if:

1. She is scared 
2. Nearly dead or dead.
3. In Combat
4. Sleeping
5. On Fire

### Multiplayer:

Now tested. Only works for the host in peer to peer games right now. However when the host hugs Virginia it syncs to other players.

I plan to allow the host to determine if they want to allow clients to hug.

data.name: Vanilla Armsys
data.shortDescription: Brings the forest Armsy sounds to Armysies in this game and they cut trees.
data.description:
Many of you may remember that in the first game Armysies cut down trees and emit a loud roar from a distance. Those behaviors are absent in the Sons of the forest versions. This mod rectifies that by bringing them back! 

You can customize the following in Mod>Configs:

1. How often the roar sound plays.
2. How loud the roar sound is.
3. How far it can be heard from.

And if you just want the tree cutting or roar, but not the other you can disable the roars and treecutting in the config options. 

Multiplayer

Purposely disabled client side in multiplayer games to prevent gameplay disruption. I haven't tested if it works in multiplayer yet. But its probably works client side if the host. Ill look into adding multiplayer syncing in the future.

Note: This mod doesn't make them spawn earlier. Use VailSpawnControl or Raid Customizer for that.

data.name: Fly Amanita Super Mushrooms
data.shortDescription: Eating Fly Amanita scales you in size and gives you tremendous power!
data.description:
All Fly Amanita mushrooms will now give you a powerful buff when you consume them. After eating these mushrooms the following happens:

1. You gain x5 size by default.
2. Double walk and run speed.
3. Trees you collide with will be cut down immediately.
4. Enemies you collide with will be instantly killed.
5. Epic Robby Battle music plays.

Other things to know:

1. Does not harm Kelvin or Virginia.
2. Does not harm structures of any kind.
3. You can customize just about everything this mod does under the Mod>Configs.

IMPORTANT: Do not open the inventory while powered up and be careful in small spaces while consuming mushrooms.

Multiplayer:

Purposely disabled for clients to prevent game disruption. However I haven't tested it in multiplayer.

data.name: Pitch Black Bunkers and Caves
data.shortDescription: Removes most light sources from Bunkers and Caves to enhance horror.
data.description:
Sons of the forest is a horror game, but some indoor locations are too handholdy with the amount of light they give you. This mod fixes that by removing light sources from caves and bunkers allowing for a much scarier experience. 

*Also this mod is heavily configurable so if saw you only want this to effect a specific cave or bunker you can handle that in the mod configs.

What this mod DOES remove or edit:

1. Most light sources.
2. Indoor Audio in Bunkers has been replaced with cave music.
3. Most glowing textures.
4. Welcome Back announcers have been shut off to give the bunkers an abandoned facility vibe.
5. Video playing monitors that are apart of background detail have either been hidden or their video frozen.

Exceptions and what this mod does not remove or darken:

1. Player made structure light sources like torches.
2. Particle effects 
3. 3D printer lights.
4. Radios. I left these alone since they drop microchips and are used for building things.
5. Some monitors are dimmed instead of switched off.
6. Mission critical computer screen exclamation lights.
7. Cutscenes are unaffected. 
8. Has no effect on glowing enemies or enemies with light sources.
9. Only affects instanced indoor locations. Not the overworld caves.

Multiplayer:

This mod is client sided sided. Works as both the host and client, but changes made will only appear for person using the mod. Coordinate with the host and client(s) to have matching settings.

data.name: Virginia Golf Cart Passenger
data.shortDescription: Allows Virginia to enter golf carts(4 sit locations available)
data.description:
This mod allows your favorite friendly mutant Virginia to be able to get in golf carts. Each golf cart now has a total of 4 places Virginia can enter and sit in golf carts. 

### She can sit on the following locations:

- The left and right side of the golf car front.
- On the solar panel from the left.
- In the front passenger seat.

### How to get her in the golf cart

There are 4 collision points added to each golf cart. Approaching these collision points will trigger her to enter depending on the entry point. See the golf cart diagram so you can see where the collision points are.

### Virginia will NOT enter the golf cart if:

1. She is scared of you.
2. She is combat aware.
3. Dying or Dead
4. Swimming
5. Sleeping(Everyone needs sleep)
6. Is burning

### Other things to know:

- She will NOT take damage while in the golf cart. However she will take damage if you approach her too fast with a golf cart.

- There is NO programming to make her move toward you once you enter a golf cart. You will have to let her come naturally or go to her.

- Her AI will work fine once she gets out of the golf cart. Tested and passed.

- For player flexibility she doesn't take up a passenger slot when in the golf cart. 

- Virginia will always spawn on the right side of the golf cart when exiting.

- This mod works fine if you have multiple Virginias. However be aware that its possible for multiple Virginia's to overlap the same golf cart spot. So drive carefully to ensure you get them the spot you want.

### Multiplayer 

This mod works in multiplayer and syncs to other players. But only the host can trigger Virginia's to get in the golf cart. This is done to prevent gameplay disruption. 

Once I learn multiplayer syncing better Ill make it so the host can let people with the admin role or special permissions do this.

*Includes 4 config options to turn off each entry point. Incase you want to prevent her getting in the wrong spot.

data.name: Virginia Gift Manager

This mod allows you to customize the following things about the Virginia Gift System:

- How long it takes between Virginia Gift Visits
- The chance of getting each gift from Virginia.

This mod will NOT allow you to choose items outside of her existing pool of items that she gives you. 

Multiplayer note:

Once I figure out multiplayer syncing I will allow the host to determine if they want clients to be able to changethese stats.

data.name: Stamina Adjuster
data.shortDescription: Allows adjustment of player stamina values.
data.description:
A simple mod that lets you tweak how stamina works in Sons of the Forest.

You can adjust things like:

- How fast stamina regenerates

- How much stamina you have overall

- How much stamina running and jumping uses

- How much stamina you need before you can start running

- Stamina penalties from cold weather

- Stat-based stamina regen effects

- Separate settings for Normal and Hard difficulty where it makes sense

- Changes apply instantly, so you can fine-tune values without restarting.

Multiplayer note:
For stability and fairness, stamina changes are server-side only. The mod is disabled for clients in multiplayer games.

Once I figure out multiplayer syncing I will allow the host to determine if they want clients to be able to adjust it.

data.name: Vampire Survival Challenge
data.shortDescription: This challenge mod places you in the role of a vampiric creature of the night. You burn during the day, herbs and artificial foods make you sick. This mod will drastically change the way you play.
data.description:
This is a challenge mod that transforms Jack Holt into a vampiric like creature(no new skin yet). Default changes in this mod:

1.The player burns during the day(hours 6-18 default) at 15 damage per 2 seconds. Using golf carts burn damage is halved by 50%. Being indoors or in caves prevents damage. This includes indoor player structures. Being underwater will also prevent damage. 

2.Most foods aside from meats, meds, twinberries and fly amanita. Severed limbs and fly amanita are consumables that have their consumed stats heavily buffed and no longer make you sick. Has no effect on oysters. Animal meat and meds have had their stats lowered, but won't cause sickness if not rotten or spoiled.

3.When starting a new save and during the final boss scene you start it at night automatically. 

4.Sleeping in caves gives you extra boosted energy. You are vampiric after all.

5.Equipping the cross will deal heavy damage to you that ignores armor.

6.Max stack of skulls increased to 12 and max severed limbs to 16. Your going to be doing a lot of killing so you'll need the space and the light sources.

7.Hydration from clean water slightly reduced.

8.All stews aside from the boiled water recipe are unaffected.

Not compatible with multiplayer yet, but that will be coming in a future update. 

This mod is designed to heavily encourage playing at night, fighting cannibals and changing up your survival routine.

data.name: Toxic Water
data.shortDescription: Amplifies the amount of sickness you get by drinking dirty water. Providing a real deterrent to drinking it. Fully configurable.
data.description:
Water will now incur 100 sickness by default. It can be configured from 20-100 sickness in the menu. Has no effect on clean water. Hydration from drinking dirty water remains the same, but you will get very sick. 

The amount of sickness can be configurated in the config options.

data.name: GPS Remover
data.shortDescription: Turns off the GPS trackers for the held GPS device and all golf cart GPS systems. Fully configurable.
data.description: Many folks prefer to find their way around the map without the temptation or assistance of GPS devices. This mod solves that in an immersion friendly way by turning off all the screens for the held GPS and golf cart GPS systems. If you want the minimap turned off, there is already an option for that in the gameplay options.

data.name: Decorative Pumpkins
data.shortDescription: Adds decorative pumpkins to the game.
data.description:
Adds decorative pumpkins to the game that can be placed on any skull. Including skulls not owned by the player. To place a pumpkin on a skull move close to one and press T. If you want all nearby skulls to have a pumpkin press Y. When placing single skulls it will place based on the closest one to the player.

 A few things to know:
1. Currently pumpkins don't save. However you can setup skulls very quickly without animations and at no cost.
2. Pumpkins can only be placed on skull items. 
3. They emit a fair amount of light which can be useful at night.
4. Removing a skull item will reset the pumpkin and require it to be placed again. 

Happy Halloween!

data.name: Mutant Baby Remover
data.shortDescription: A mod that removes mutant babies and replaces them with other enemies.
data.description:
Do you absolutely detest mutant babies? If so this is the mod for you!  Not only does this mod remove mutant babies, but it lets you replace them with other way cooler enemies. In the config options you can set the enemies you want mutant baby spawns to be replaced with or none all. Just delete them and be done with it. There is also a spawn babies key for you to test this mod out yourself without having to find some first. 

Warning! Be very careful. Mutant babies usually spawn in large numbers. So if you replace them with tough enemies there will be lots of them. 

This mod doesn't change the spawn rate in any way. Plays well with raid customizer. Should work in multiplayer too.

Works for all mutant baby spawns. Including those in caves and those spawned directly via command.

data.name: Alternate Kelvin and Virginia Outfits
data.shortDescription: Adds alternate hidden Virginia & Kelvin Outfits and customization for use  in the game.
data.description:
There are few hidden outfits that are normally not accessible in the game directly. This mod adds those outfits for use within the config settings. Additionally it gives you the option to customize some of the already existing outfit pieces to mix and match to a degree. The new outfits this game adds are as follows:

Kelvin:

-Golden Armor
-Priest Outfit.

Virginia:

-Red Dress
-White Dress

Additional customization options:

-Can now enable the sunglasses on Kelvin regardless of outfit.
-Can now enable all of Virginia's shoes except her dress shoes on any outfit.
-Can also disable any shoes regardless of outfit.

Credits: 
Special thanks to Shoko for teaching me how to enable and disable game objects.

data.name: Virginia Alternate Hair
data.shortDescription: Activates Virginia's alternative hairstyle thats used during the end game cutscenes.
data.description: This mod activates Virginia's end game cutscene hairstyle. This hairstyle is normally hidden most of the time and this mod allows you to enable at any time. While active it turns off the other one. This mod is compatible with all mods except Shoko's bald head mod. However chance are that if you are using this mod, you won't be using that one.
